style: emoji-heavy texting, fragments, no capitals; thinks the problem is the park until the fourth entry

situations.name: Going to the park playground (the real trigger is off-leash dogs there)
situations.feared_outcome: A dog will run at me and bite my face

behaviors.text: Says his legs hurt or he is tired so they go home instead of to the park
Climbs up mom and wants to be carried whenever a dog is in sight
Asks over and over whether there will be dogs there before going

accommodations.text: Mom takes him to the indoor trampoline park instead of the park
Mom tells him she checked and there are no dogs, or that the dog is on a leash

situations.name: Visiting Grandpa's house (Grandpa has a big dog, Gus)

behaviors.text: Only gets out of the car and goes inside once Gus is shut in the backyard
Runs back out to the car when Gus barks at the back door

accommodations.text: Mom texts Grandpa from the driveway to shut Gus out back (or in the garage) before Teddy comes in

situations.name: Walking past the neighbor's fenced yard with a barking dog
situations.feared_outcome: The dog will jump over the fence

behaviors.text: Pulls mom across the street so they don't pass the fence

accommodations.text: Mom crosses the street with him

monitoring_log.child_behavior_observed: said his legs hurt 😩 didnt want to go. wanted to go home and play minecraft
asked like 5x if there would be dogs there 🐶❓❓ then begged for the trampoline park
monitoring_log.parent_response: took all 3 kids to the indoor trampoline park instead 🙃💸

monitoring_log.child_behavior_observed: the big dog behind the fence on the corner started barking 🐕💥 he yanked me to the other side of the street
would NOT unbuckle til Gus was out back 😬 then came in totally fine and played legos
monitoring_log.parent_response: texted grandpa from the driveway to put Gus out 📱

monitoring_log.parent_words: ok I finally get it 💡💡 its not the park its the DOGS. sat morning a yellow lab got off leash by the swings and he screamed and climbed me like a tree 🌳😭 hes way too big for that and I still held him the whole rest of the time. in the car he said the dog was gonna bite his face. he said 9 on the thermometer

monitoring_log.child_behavior_observed: are there dogs are there dogs 🔁🔁 before we even had shoes on. at the park he stayed on top of the climbing thing and yelled when one walked by
monitoring_log.parent_response: I said I checked and there were none (there was one 😬 sorry dr)

monitoring_log.child_behavior_observed: came in once Gus was out. then Gus barked at the slider and he ran straight back out to the car 🏃‍♂️💨
monitoring_log.parent_response: sat in the car w him like 20 min 😮‍💨 grandpa moved Gus to the garage and then he came back in

monitoring_log.child_behavior_observed: went!! 🎉 but tried to climb up on me every time a dog walked past 🐶
monitoring_log.parent_response: held him up twice then put him down and said he could stand next to me 💪

voice_notes.text: um so today at the park there were like three dogs and he did the thing again where he climbs up me so I was holding him basically the whole time and he kept going is it gonna come over here is it gonna come over here and I kept saying no no buddy it's on a leash um and he said it was an eight
voice_notes.trap: 'three dogs' is a count, not a fear level; the fear level is 8

voice_notes.text: ok two things so this morning at grandpa's he stayed in the car til gus was out back like usual I texted my dad from the driveway and then uh later walking home he made me cross the street at the fence house again with the barky dog
